image_open_rules: Open every current original candidate and every required local reference/source/expected path in this job with tools.view_image.
One new opening of the identical local reference path may cover all explicitly listed cases in this job. Different local paths with the same SHA each require a new opening.
No prior Reader run, old six-opening record, C16 candidate PNG, contact sheet, prior pixel verdict, mechanical PASS, or state field gives fresh-image credit.

Keep each source/reference/processed/expected role distinct. No image processing, crops, resizing, or unplanned diff opening. Any additional necessary image must fit the hard eight-opening and four-TOTAL-pair limits and be recorded.

If a necessary glyph/detail is unreadable, leave that check pending and ask the sole coordinator for owner-generated original-scale crop evidence with source/output SHA, dimensions, ROI, scale/algorithm and command/owner. Do not generate crops or exceed budget.
review_checks: Review the current capture against both the independently opened exact design reference and the same-case source-composition group; the source-composition group counts as one TOTAL pair.

Open both own processed inputs, the expected composition, the current capture, and the necessary independent design reference: five required openings. Do not open the diff unless necessary and within the assigned budget.

Closed Reader is artwork only: inspect all visible edges, seam, margins and captions; no app footer, bookmark ribbon, page/status label, download notice or debug decoration. Separate declared source-art borders/captions from app chrome.

Record RTL first/second page placement and fit/padding only to the extent visibly supported by the assigned original source/expected/current evidence. Oracle exact_match and zero-difference metrics do not replace actual visual review.
R1 uses only adopted reader-control-02 run 7f7bbba67c55. Prior RAW and erroneous observer cases remain preserved diagnostic failures and carry no new credit.
allowed_work: Static local frozen evidence text and tools.view_image only. Read the complete contract first. Read and announce UI/UX Pro Max on first use; never run its search program.
prohibited_work: Do not start this draft assignment before sole coordinator registration.
No child worker spawning, image queue continuation or additional task scope.
No SSH, local or remote applications, tests, builds, smoke checks, runtime probes, validators, SQL, hash commands, AST tools, Python/PIL, file copying or image processing.

Do not read current production source as frozen visual evidence; do not modify production, harness, plans, captured originals, existing files/reports, registries or ledgers; no PR/issue writes or external messages.
No Root/global clean claim, native/full/performance/physical/device/lease/input/sleep-wake/e-ink credit; no transfer of C16 or historical candidate acceptance.
Do not relabel original failures. The optional final collection record is context only and does not replace assigned actual openings.
